subject: Genetics
title: Curing Blindness
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Curing Blindness.

hook.text: In 2017, the FDA approved Luxturna—a gene therapy that restores sight to people with inherited retinal blindness.

buildup.text: The RPE65 gene is broken in these patients. Without it, retinal cells can't process light. Darkness is permanent.

discovery.text: Luxturna injects a working RPE65 gene directly under the retina. Within weeks, patients see light for the first time.

twist.text: It costs $850,000 for both eyes. Insurance battles are fierce. Many eligible patients can't access it.

climax.text: Luxturna proved gene therapy works for real patients.

punchline.text: One injection. Light enters eyes that never saw it.
